Enchiladas Catalinas.description: Three shredded chicken enchiladas in chile guajillo sauce, topped with steamed potatoes and carrots, avocado, homemade queso fresco, Mexican crema, and shredded lettuce

Enchiladas Suizas.description: Four shredded chicken and cheese enchiladas smothered in a creamy cilantro-tomatillo sauce, topped with Heber Valley Artisan Cheese, Mexican crema, and avocado

Enchiladas Rojas.description: Three chicken or cheese enchiladas smothered in our smoky red chile guajillo sauce, topped with Heber Valley Artisan Cheese

Enchiladas Verdes.description: Three chicken or cheese enchiladas with queso Oaxaca, smothered in our tangy green tomatillo sauce, topped with Heber Valley Artisan Cheese

Enchiladas De Mole.description: Three chicken or cheese enchiladas with Monterrey-pepper jack cheese, smothered in our spicy-sweet Micha-Poblano mole, topped with Heber Valley Artisan Cheese

Tacos.description: Three homemade corn tortillas, choice of protein, fresh salsa, and lime *Topped with chopped onion & fresh cilantro* Grilled Chicken, Slow Braised Pork (Carnitas), Steak, or Slow Braised Beef (Birria) *Topped with crema cilantro, pico, & pickled onions* Sautéed Veggies or Shrimp

Burrito.description: Large flour tortilla filled with choice of protein, Mexican rice, refried beans, and Monterrey-pepper jack cheese, smothered in mole, red guajillo, or green tomatillo salsa, topped with Heber Valley Artisan Cheese

Fajitas.description: Choice of protein, sautéed bell peppers and red onions, served with fresh guacamole, Mexican crema, a side and tortillas of choice

Sopes.description: Three thick fried corn masa base, refried beans, choice of protein, homemade queso fresco, fresh avocado, Mexican crema, pico de gallo, shredded lettuce, and pickled onions Choose from: Carnitas, Avocado, Tinga (Smoky Tomato-Chipotle Chicken), or Steak
